# TradingView

> TradingView is a comprehensive charting platform and social network for traders offering real-time market data, technical analysis tools, and live quotes across stocks, indices, cryptocurrencies, and forex markets.

TradingView provides professional-grade charting tools, market quotes, and trading data for millions of traders worldwide. The platform serves as both a technical analysis hub and a community for sharing trading ideas and strategies.

## Key Topics

- Technical Analysis
- Real-Time Market Data
- Charting Tools
- Stock Indices

- S&P 500

- [S&P 500 Index Chart — SPX Quote — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/SPX): Live S&P 500 Index chart with technical analysis and market data

- [UKX Index Charts and Quotes — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/FTSE-UKX): FTSE 100 Index chart with UK stock market quotes and analysis
- [PX1 Index Charts and Quotes — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/EURONEXT-PX1): CAC 40 Index chart for EURONEXT market data and analysis
- [Japan 225 Chart – NI225 Quote — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/TVC-NI225): Live Nikkei 225 Index chart with price tracking and market data
- [000001 Index Charts and Quotes — TradingView](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/SSE-000001): SSE Composite Index chart for Shanghai Stock Exchange tracking
